rv.q: THE PROM is so incredibly jubilant, upbeat and full of love that theatergoers will never want it to end.
The mostly professional community theatre company puts on a high-energy, praiseworthy Prom .

The orchestra led by Musical Director Ken Preuss never overpowered the voices of the performers , making for a wonderful evening of theater, and a story that is worth viewing by a cast that is worthy of the standing ovation they received.

cn.t: Critics praise this "glitzy, glittery musical with a heart" as jubilant and hilariously poignant, with anthemic ballads and an important message that puts smiles on faces and opens doors for fresh talent.
